changelog:
- Added support for QQ bot notifications, including sending to personal QQ via bot or to QQ groups via channel option.
- Updated documentation to cover new QQ bot and QQ group features, parameters, and usage examples.
- Bumped API and open API versions to 1.17.
- Removed obsolete sample card file (skill-card.md).
summary: Send push notifications via pushplus HTTP API to WeChat, ClawBot, QQ bot (direct message or QQ group), email, webhook, SMS, App and more; also manage messages, topics, friends, friend/topic-user blacklists, channels, ClawBot and QQ bot binding/groups via Open API when needed. Use when the user asks
